'''Construction''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Windmill]] and the [[Burn Forest]] ability. The Windmill is a [[building]] that produces one [[population]] for every friendly adjacent [[Farm]]. The Burn Forest ability replaces an empty Forest with a field with crop at a cost of 5 stars.

Prior to the [[Path of the Ocean]] update, Construction unlocked the [[Destroy]] ability. 

==Recycling==

[[File:Decompose.png|thumb|left|The Decompose icon]]

[[Cymanti]] has the '''Recycling''' technology instead of Construction. Recycling unlocks the [[Decompose]] ability and Microbes. Decompose is identical to the Destroy ability except that Decompose removes the building or ruin at the end of the turn (instead of immediately) and returns a building's full cost.

Microbes allow all [[Fungi]] to grow one additional level. They were added in the Cymanti rework (version 115).
